## Installation Instructions

1. Download the experimental build of [UE4SS](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases) (as of writing, use the `experimental-latest`).
2. Extract the UE4SS files into `Project Silverfish/SilverFish/Binaries/Win64`.
3. Extract the `AdjustableScope` folder from this `.zip` file into `Project Silverfish/SilverFish/Binaries/Win64/ue4ss/Mods`.
4. Make sure that `enabled.txt` is present inside `AdjustableScope`.

## Usage

1. Start the game and equip a weapon.
2. Aim down sights (ADS).
3. Use configured keybinds to adjust scope magnification and zeroing distance.
4. Press `F1` to reset zoom and zeroing to default.

## Configuration

Edit `config.ini` inside the `AdjustableScope` folder to configure keybinds, stepped zoom stages, dynamic zoom step, sound effects, and debug logging.
